learnedRules.rule: Broad Index Filter: If Nifty synthetic buy pressure is < 45%, ignore individual stock Buy Absorption signals (Index drag has 85% probability of breaking stock support).
Whale Order Size Filter: A Top-5 Bid skew > 70% is only valid if Whale Ratio (Avg Bid Size / Avg Ask Size) is >= 1.8. Avoid high order counts with small lots (retail trap).
Lunchtime False Wall Warning: Between 12:15 PM and 1:00 PM (Period G), book depth thins out. Reduce conviction on imbalance signals unless backed by volume > 1.2x.
